name: Gronw Pebyr

attributes.attribute: woman made from flowers for Lleu
struck the blows that killed Lleu

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gronw Pebyr is a Welsh hero who fell in love with Blodeuwedd. The sage Gwydion had shaped Blodeuwedd from flowers to be the wife of Lleu Llaw Gyffes. Weary of her flower-born husband, Blodeuwedd told Gronw of his weakness, and Gronw struck the fatal blows.

okr.objective: Present Gronw Pebyr as the lover who helped kill the flower-born husband.
key_results: Gwydion made a flower-wife for Lleu.
Gronw Pebyr struck the fatal blows.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore, 2003
